preconditions.name: external_task_occupancy_reachable
preconditions.description: the contested external_task mode is genuinely occupied on BOTH arms -- per-seed min over arms of fraction_in_external_task > OCCUPANCY_FLOOR -- on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds. This is the SAME statistic (occupancy) the load-bearing C1 criterion routes on (V3-EXQ-643 same-statistic rule), re-stating the 464c n_switches>=1 gate that certified episode-boundary settles. A zero-occupancy read is mode-governance-not-engaged (possibly the unresolved nav-competence dependency), NOT a MECH-266 falsification.
preconditions.control: fraction of guard-passing seeds with per-seed min-arm fraction_in_external_task > OCCUPANCY_FLOOR.

contact_guard.definition: per-seed P2 contact_rate > 0 AND z_goal_norm_at_contact_peak > 0.4; < 2/3 seeds -> substrate_not_ready_requeue.

occupancy_non_vacuity_gate.definition: per-seed min over arms of fraction_in_external_task > OCCUPANCY_FLOOR on >= 2/3 guard-passing seeds (the SAME statistic C1 routes on). Below floor -> substrate_not_ready_requeue (non_contributory), NEVER a false weakens. Re-states the 464c n_switches>=1 gate.
